fact: SIGOMAP is now the only platform for managing public procurement, after a pilot with seven structures; its operation extends to all ministries' contracting authorities from 2024, and the tender-file processing time fell from 9.9 to 6.5 days owing to dematerialisation.
title: Communication en Conseil des Ministres: Situation des opérations de passation des marchés publics au titre de la gestion 2023
